data.name: Aquatechnik Pool Service
data.address: 2201 Long Prairie Rd #107812, Flower Mound, TX 75022

reviews.text:
I'm delighted to share my fantastic experience with Jay and his company's pool repair service. From start to finish, they demonstrated an unmatched level of professionalism and expertise. Jay himself was a pleasure to work with, offering clear communication and guidance throughout the process.

The repair work performed on my pool was nothing short of exceptional. Jay's team displayed a remarkable attention to detail, ensuring that every issue was addressed and resolved efficiently. Not only did they fix the problems I initially reported, but they also took the time to identify and rectify potential future issues, giving me peace of mind.

What truly sets Jay and his company apart is their commitment to customer satisfaction. They went above and beyond to ensure that I was not only satisfied but genuinely impressed with the final results. The quality of their work is top-notch, and I can confidently say that my pool has never looked better.

If you're in need of pool repair services, I wholeheartedly recommend Jay and his company. Their professionalism, expertise, and dedication to excellence make them a standout choice. Thank you, Jay, for your outstanding service and for turning my pool into a sparkling oasis once again!
reviews.author: EL PROFE DE LA CIUDADANIA

reviews.text: I left a voicemail with Jay after receiving his information from another customer of his that gave him a glowing review. Jay returned my call quickly and was able to sort out our issue after seeing just a few pictures of the pool hardware. Within a day or two our pool pump was fixed and ready to run good as new. He also checked in after a few days to make sure everything was still running well. I cannot recommend Aquatechnik Pool Service enough.
reviews.author: James Stocum

reviews.text: Jay at Aquatechnik Pool Service has been servicing our pool for over three years.  Our pool has NEVER looked better.  Jay is there every week checking the chemicals, cleaning the baskets and taking care of any equipment repairs we need.  He is great to work with and very reasonable.  Well worth the weekly fee to be able to enjoy our pool without worry.
reviews.author: Susan Williamson

reviews.text: I am so glad that we found Jay Nance!  Before we hired Jay, we tried to maintain our pool ourselves to save money, but we could not be happier with the service that Aquatechnik and Jay have provided to us since 2015.  From the start, Jay had our salt water pool running smoothly and looking great without all the expensive upgrades that other pool companies tried to sell us.  He always communicates with us promptly and clearly about any issues that need our attention.  Most importantly, I trust Jay to give me reliable advice about how to keep the pool in top shape without unnecessary expenditures.  He is hardworking and trustworthy; and I recommend him and his company wholeheartedly.
reviews.author: Nicole Manna

reviews.text: I would give Jay six stars if I could.  He is reliable, responsive and knowledgeable.  His technical background makes him very good at diagnosing problems and solving them the right way the first time.  For example, during the “big freeze” of February 2021, my heater sprung a leak resulting in a pool shut-down.  Because of the demand on local inventory, the part I needed was not available anywhere in the DFW area.  But that didn’t stop Jay.  His persistence located the part … in Denver, and in two days, my pool was back online.  Before I started service with Jay, I maintained my own pool.  My expectations for quality service are very high and I am completely comfortable with Jay, knowing that, no matter what the issue, from weekly service to repairs, it’s being handled effectively.
reviews.author: Paul B

reviews.text: Aquatechnik Pools has been doing my pool service for the last six months.  He is very knowledgeable, shows up consistently, and always makes sure my pool looks great and clean.  I can easily reach him if I have any problems or issues.  I would definitely recommend him for your weekly pool service.
reviews.author: Jennifer Mazza

reviews.text: We have been with Aquatechnik Pool Service for over 3 years.  They are professional and prompt with our weekly service and have been able to fix every pool problem that arises.  We had two emergency repairs and it was such a relief that we could contact them and they took care of it right away.  Aquatechnik treats my pool like it was their own pool.  I can fully recommend Aquatechnik pools to take care of your pool service.
reviews.author: Cindi C

reviews.text: Aquatechnik Pool Service has been providing service for our family for over 3 years and has exceeded expectations.  He is reliable, honest and quality work and pool maintenance is provided every week!  We will never use anyone else.  We highly recommend Aquatechnik Pool Service the customer service is above and beyond!!
reviews.author: cari arcuri
